name: Universal Logistics - Columbus Terminal - Columbus OH

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 2950 International St, Columbus, OH 43228 via the loadmatch.com intermodal directory (Universal Intermodal Services, Inc. / Columbus OH, companyID 5853). Address independently corroborated by iBegin, Superpages, and Yelp listings (all show 2950 International St, phone 614-777-9393, also branded 'Mason Dixon Lines' — a Universal/ULH operating brand). The geocoding-API rooftop point (40.0129, -83.1330) landed on a neighboring multi-tenant DC; the terminal yard is the parcel ~150 m east, fronting International St — confirmed by a Street View 'Universal Intermodal Services' sign on the property fence (pano 2021-07).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View along International St (2021-07) shows the truck entrance driveway is a wide open paved apron meeting International St — NO barrier arm, NO sliding/swing gate across the truck lane. The container yard has perimeter chain-link fencing along the road frontage, but the entrance driveway itself is uncontrolled and open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance or anywhere on the property in satellite or Street View. Only an L-shaped metal office/equipment-shop building is present.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No truck gate (open uncontrolled entrance), so no remote check-in implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: NONE — this is a drayage/intermodal terminal yard, not a cross-dock. The only building is an office/equipment-shop with no rhythm of loading-dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 50+. Street View (2021) showed the yard densely stacked with ocean containers (MSC, Maersk and others). 2026 satellite shows the yard dominated by flatbed/chassis rows carrying steel/material loads plus parked trailers — a large working drop/storage yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The wide gravel/paved yard provides deep stacking between International St and the yard interior — 3+ trucks could queue inside without spilling onto the road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The entrance apron is very wide with substantial unused paved width — physical room to add a bypass/express lane exists.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two structures: a long L-shaped office/equipment-shop building near the SW corner and a small adjacent shed.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the parcel. It is a truck drayage terminal in the I-270 / West Belt Dr corridor that interchanges with the nearby CSX Columbus intermodal ramp; rail does not enter the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~21.8 acres computed from the perimeter box — a large open terminal yard bounded by International St (W) and the I-270 / rail corridor tree line (N/E).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~40 trailers/chassis estimated from 2026 satellite — low confidence, the yard is irregularly loaded.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~200 — the yard is mostly open gravel/paved and could hold a large number of trailers/chassis/containers; honest estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the west-Columbus industrial fabric (43228, I-270/I-70 corridor) — Urban.
